subject: RetailOps — post-call recap, VP/CTO intro & next steps
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-06T21:02:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap — RetailOps discovery, proposed next steps

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for a focused call this morning — good to map the priorities and constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock timelines: 

Recap:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for search-ranking models while keeping P95 latency < 120ms for 512-token requests.
- Workloads: batch re-ranks (off-peak), real-time ranking for high-traffic pages, embeddings for similarity pipelines.
- Main constraints: data residency in us-west, SOC2 evidence required, procurement early July.

Proposed next steps:
1) VP/CTO intro (30 min) — executive alignment to unblock procurement and confirm risk appetite. Ideally this happens before the technical deep dive so execs can set success criteria.
2) Technical deep dive (60–90 min) — infra owners, SRE, and ML platform to walk current infra and sample workload.
3) Draft mutual action plan + SOW v0.2 (attached) — we’ll pull a short proposal for pilot scope.

For the VP/CTO intro, here are a couple of windows we have next week (PT):
- Tue 2026-06-09, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 2026-06-11, 14:00–14:30 PT

If neither works, send a couple of options that suit Samir/CTO. For the technical deep dive I’m suggesting a 90-minute slot the following week so we can include infra diagrams and a short live perf run.

Attachments: RetailOps_SOW_v0.2.pdf (draft)
Call recording: link in Drive (see related links)

Ask: Can you confirm preferred VP/CTO slot and the attendee list for both sessions? I’ll freeze calendar invites once we agree.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Note: We plan to include an abbreviated cost/latency runbook in the technical deep dive.
